purpose: Frozen probability forecasts for the blind forward test. Each completed week, look up the ratio's zone and record P(ratio lower after 13/26/52 weeks). Scored with the Brier score against a 50% coin flip and the long-run base rate. Do not edit; add p2 with a new start week instead.
method: World Bank monthly-average gold/silver ratio 1972-01 to 2026-10. Zone base rates using non-overlapping effective sample sizes (months / horizon), shrunk toward 50% as (k_eff+1)/(n_eff+2). 13/26/52 weeks map to 3/6/12 months.
